title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights. You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making. Responsibilities Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively Requirements Strong SQL skills Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics Comfortable working in a remote environment Able to pass a background check Preferred Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data Experience with BI and visualization tools Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment Experience with AWS-based data environments Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts How to Apply Please send your resume in English.

title: Ai Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Operations Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Our Client Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain. Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought\ "this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\ " this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic\ "growing your trucking business\ " pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems) Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings Field & Event Activation Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works Internal AI Tooling Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering What We're Looking For Required 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL;
comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time Strongly Preferred Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration You'll thrive here if you Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing;
You'd rather ship a v1in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers;
their adoption of whatyou build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes What Success Looks Like By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team;
outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Desenvolvedor Abap Sênior – Sustentação & Evolução
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Abap Sênior – Sustentação & Evolução em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Responsabilidades e atribuições Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP. Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto. Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações\ "Z\" tradicionais em favor deextensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes. Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance. Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna. Requisitos e qualificações Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+;
Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban. #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges. The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services, as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters. Key Responsibilities Provide technical accounting advisory services, including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis. Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations. Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards. Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices. Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes. Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing. Qualifications & Experience 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit. Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred. Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks. CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress). Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Abap Sênior – Sustentação & Evolução em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Responsabilidades e atribuições Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP. Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto. Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações\ "Z\" tradicionais em favor deextensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes. Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance. Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna. Requisitos e qualificações Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+;
Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban. #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Sr. Compliance Onboarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance Onboarding Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance. Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices. Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions. Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions. Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks. Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters. What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance. 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments. Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly. Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus). Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero. 3) Mentalidade\ "TaxTech\" Você vê atecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário. O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria: - Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.

Você se identifica com este perfil? title: Médico Cardiologista

Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! * O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios cardiológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em cardiologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças cardiológica s. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM CARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em cardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado ;
ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Cardiologia.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written. Excellent phone and email etiquette. Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities. CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system. description:

About Our Client Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain. Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought\ "this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\ " this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic\ "growing your trucking business\ " pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems) Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings Field & Event Activation Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works Internal AI Tooling Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering What We're Looking For Required 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL;
comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time Strongly Preferred Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration You'll thrive here if you Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing;
You'd rather ship a v1in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers;
their adoption of whatyou build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes What Success Looks Like By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team;
outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Ai Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Operations Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Our Client Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain. Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought\ "this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\ " this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic\ "growing your trucking business\ " pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems) Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings Field & Event Activation Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works Internal AI Tooling Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering What We're Looking For Required 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL;
comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time Strongly Preferred Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration You'll thrive here if you Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing;
You'd rather ship a v1in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers;
their adoption of whatyou build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes What Success Looks Like By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team;
outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field. Advanced spoken and written English skills. Why Join Us? Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure. Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture. Competitive compensation and benefits package. This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição. Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.Js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos. O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.Js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa. Quais são os requisitos? Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;
Experiência de 2+ anoscom Node.Js e TypeScript em produção Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;
Experiência de 2+ anoscom Tecnologias Web em produção;
Experiência de 2+ anoscom Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem;
Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);
Conhecimentode frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.Js;
Conhecimentoem padrõesde arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);
Conhecimentosólido em Git e versionamento de código;
Vivência commetodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa. Será um diferencial: Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;
Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);
Conhecimentoprático naintegração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents. O que oferecemos? Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
6 dias de folga anuais+ folga de aniversário;
Bônus de indicação;
Bônus de equipe;
Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
Horários flexíveis;
Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias! Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

Experiência com aplicações de média/alta escala.

title: Veeva Support Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veeva Support Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Required Skills & Experience - Experience with the life science and healthcare industry.
- Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and validation processes in a regulated environment.
- Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments.
- Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.G., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience - Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus. Job Description A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. This role provides comprehensive technical support and system management across multiple regulatory and document management platforms. Responsibilities include end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs Vaults, encompassing issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive monitoring. The position collaborates with BOT development teams to deliver Veeva RIM API endpoints for automation and integration, and contributes to configuring the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite to ensure streamlined compliance tracking. Acting as the technical point of contact for PleaseReview (both standalone and Veeva-integrated), the role manages user access, configuration, performance optimization, and license administration. Additional duties include setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, lifecycle management of Lorenz docuBridge (including user provisioning and licensing), and support for Lorenz iSubmit installation, configuration, and issue resolution to meet submission standards. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.Js + React + Php
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.Js + React + Php em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Quem somos? Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição. Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.Js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos. O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.Js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa. Quais são os requisitos? Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;
Experiência de 2+ anoscom Node.Js e TypeScript em produção Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;
Experiência de 2+ anoscom Tecnologias Web em produção;
Experiência de 2+ anoscom Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem;
Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);
Conhecimentode frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.Js;
Conhecimentoem padrõesde arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);
Conhecimentosólido em Git e versionamento de código;
Vivência commetodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa. Será um diferencial: Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;
Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;

Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success. Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step;
enabling them to unlockvaluable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys. Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution. THE ROLE The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO Learning Lab Architecture & Management Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms. System Administration & Support Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs. Reporting & Documentation Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required. WHAT IT TAKES Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for education technology and continuous improvement. Be fully aligned to our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.
